claim_ceiling: This packet proves only that direct activation of the admitted disposable adapter is not evaluable without vacuity and that three structurally admissible product-direction choices are ready for the owner gate. It selects no direction, starts no construction, approves or admits no successor, activates no runtime, and authorizes no live execution, migration, cutover, publication, deployment, or external effect.
